credentials.name: Who am I
credentials.description: A made-up token for the whoami tools, which show which account the platform calls tools as.
credentials.help: Any value that starts with whoami- is accepted, for example whoami-user-<your name>. Without your own, your team's or the tenant's is used; the local stack gives the operator's whoami-operator to every tenant.

credentials.name: Who am I API key
credentials.description: Your own made-up API key for the lab team's whoami tools, sent in the X-Api-Key header. Each person uses their own.
credentials.help: Any value that starts with whoami-, for example whoami-key-<your name>.

mcp_servers.name: Who am I
mcp_servers.description: Shows which account the platform calls tools as: yours, your team's or the tenant's.

mcp_servers.name: Who am I (API key)
mcp_servers.description: The same tools, called with each person's own API key in a custom header.
